title: Making Zoodles (Zucchini Noodles) with Garlic
summary: Gather garlic and zucchini, peel and mince garlic, spiralize zucchini, then sauté garlic and zoodles briefly in oil, season, and serve.
source: open-set draft from 8 frames + the person's description 'making Zoodles'

nodes.name: Review the recipe
nodes.instruction_novice: Read through the recipe on your tablet so you know what's coming.
nodes.end_state: Recipe is open on the tablet next to the stove.

checks.question: Is this step done: Review the recipe?

nodes.name: Gather garlic and zucchini
nodes.instruction_novice: Grab a garlic clove or two and your zucchini from the pantry or fridge.
nodes.end_state: Garlic and zucchini sit on the counter.

checks.question: Is this step done: Gather garlic and zucchini?

nodes.name: Get knife and tools
nodes.instruction_novice: Get a sharp knife, a cutting board, and your spiralizer.
nodes.end_state: Knife, board, and spiralizer are on the counter.

checks.question: Is this step done: Get knife and tools?

nodes.name: Peel the garlic cloves
nodes.instruction_novice: Trim the root end and peel the papery skin off each clove with the knife.
nodes.end_state: Clean white garlic cloves with skins removed.

checks.question: Is this step done: Peel the garlic cloves?

nodes.name: Mince the garlic
nodes.instruction_novice: Slice the cloves thin, then rock the knife across them until finely chopped.
nodes.end_state: A small pile of minced garlic on the board.

checks.question: Is this step done: Mince the garlic?

nodes.name: Wash and trim zucchini
nodes.instruction_novice: Rinse the zucchini and cut off both ends so they sit flat.
nodes.end_state: Clean zucchini with both ends cut flat.

checks.question: Is this step done: Wash and trim zucchini?

nodes.name: Spiralize the zucchini
nodes.instruction_novice: Secure a zucchini in the spiralizer and turn the handle to make long noodles.
nodes.end_state: A pile of long zucchini noodles in a bowl.

checks.question: Is this step done: Spiralize the zucchini?

nodes.name: Blot excess moisture
nodes.instruction_novice: Pat the noodles with a paper towel to remove extra water so they don't get soggy.
nodes.end_state: Zoodles look drier on paper towels.

checks.question: Is this step done: Blot excess moisture?

nodes.name: Heat oil in pan
nodes.instruction_novice: Put a pan on medium heat and add a tablespoon of olive oil.
nodes.end_state: Oil shimmers in the pan on the stove.

checks.question: Is this step done: Heat oil in pan?

nodes.name: Sauté the garlic
nodes.instruction_novice: Add the garlic and stir for about 30 seconds until fragrant, not brown.
nodes.end_state: Garlic sizzles lightly golden in the oil.

checks.question: Is this step done: Sauté the garlic?

nodes.name: Cook the zoodles
nodes.instruction_novice: Add the zoodles and toss gently for 2 to 3 minutes until just tender.
nodes.end_state: Zoodles are bright green and slightly softened in the pan.

checks.question: Is this step done: Cook the zoodles?

nodes.name: Season to taste
nodes.instruction_novice: Sprinkle with salt, pepper, and any extras like parmesan or red pepper flakes.
nodes.end_state: Seasoning is visible on the zoodles.

checks.question: Is this step done: Season to taste?

nodes.name: Plate and serve
nodes.instruction_novice: Turn off the heat and move the zoodles to a plate right away.
nodes.end_state: Plated zoodles with the burner turned off.

checks.question: Is this step done: Plate and serve?
